//: The Java + DSA skill graph — the prerequisite DAG the roadmap engine walks.
//id: 'id' is a stable human-readable key used everywhere (levels, edges, weights).
//tags: 'tags' are the keys goal_profiles weights match against, to reorder the roadmap.
//prerequisites: 'prerequisites' become skill_prerequisites edges; the graph MUST stay acyclic.

skills.title: Java Basics
skills.description: Variables, data types, input/output, and program structure.

skills.title: Operators & Expressions
skills.description: Arithmetic, relational, logical operators and expression evaluation.

skills.title: Conditionals
skills.description: Decision-making with if / else-if / else and switch.

skills.title: Loops
skills.description: Repetition with for, while, and do-while loops.

skills.title: Methods
skills.description: Defining and calling methods, parameters, and return values.

skills.title: Arrays
skills.description: Fixed-size sequences: declaration, indexing, and iteration.

skills.title: Strings
skills.description: String manipulation, common methods, and character handling.

skills.title: OOP Basics
skills.description: Classes, objects, fields, constructors, and encapsulation.

skills.title: OOP Advanced
skills.description: Inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces, and abstract classes.

skills.title: Exceptions & Error Handling
skills.description: try/catch/finally, checked vs unchecked exceptions, and writing your own.

skills.title: Recursion
skills.description: Solving problems by having a method call itself; base cases.

skills.title: Time Complexity
skills.description: Big-O notation and reasoning about how algorithms scale.

skills.title: Collections
skills.description: Java's List, Set, and Map and when to use each.

skills.title: Searching
skills.description: Linear search and binary search on sorted data.

skills.title: Sorting
skills.description: Bubble, selection, insertion, and an intro to merge sort.

skills.title: Linked Lists
skills.description: Node-based sequences: traversal, insertion, and deletion.

skills.title: Stacks & Queues
skills.description: LIFO and FIFO structures and their classic uses.

skills.title: Hashing
skills.description: Hash maps and hash sets for O(1) lookup patterns.

skills.title: Trees (Basics)
skills.description: Binary trees and traversals (in/pre/post-order).

skills.title: Interview Patterns
skills.description: Two-pointer, sliding window, and frequency-map patterns.
